direction: Space beyond the self: living banyan shade, a courtyard’s small act of care, and the vulnerable edge of ice. Green density, warm open earth and pale cold planes vary the visual rhythm. Keep the unnamed object and direct arguments in the words. New interpretation, not a historical editorial theme.

items.title: Time beneath the branches
items.rationale: The banyan addresses human anxiety about time against the continuity of shared shade. Show its living architecture at an ordinary human scale, not an immortal fantasy tree or a crowd of symbolic inhabitants.

review.notes: Normal-size review: grounded root columns and free-hanging strands have distinct roles and believable attachment. Irregular overlapping canopy produces plausible dappled shade; broad painted leaves and open earth keep attention selective. The tree provides shared space without invented occupants, shrine or fantasy antiquity. Warm matte gouache supports the poem’s contrast with human clocks.

items.alt: Irregular aerial roots and rooted columns create a quiet patch of shade beneath a banyan canopy.

items.title: Room for the morning
items.rationale: Madhumaya asks for freedom and unforced life, including a cared-for courtyard welcoming morning with jhoti-chita. Choose that single grounded gesture and leave the river, bird and night in the words. KB cultural context describes restrained white rice-paste threshold drawing within an imagined Odisha home.

review.notes: Normal-size review: the cropped white lotus loops read as a simple hand-drawn rice-paste threshold gesture, not a symmetrical mandala or invented script. Directional morning light is consistent with the threshold and softly interrupted near its edge. Open warm earth dominates; no staged vessel or decorative clutter. The poem’s request for cared-for morning space remains the focus.

items.alt: A cropped white rice-paste lotus curve lies on warm earth where morning light reaches an Odisha-inspired threshold.

items.title: At the edge of the ice
items.rationale: Glacier expresses care and alarm for vulnerable ice and life. Accompany that emotional appeal with a restrained study of melting ice; do not illustrate or assert the poem’s speculative scientific claims.

review.notes: Normal-size review: heavy ice rests against dark stone, irregular fissures and the small meltwater channel establish physical contact and scale. Cool transparent washes and reserved pale areas remain restrained; no crystalline fantasy, dramatic disaster, animals or speculative organisms. The image accompanies the emotional appeal without asserting the poem’s scientific statements.

items.alt: Pale glacier ice rests against dark stone beside a narrow channel of meltwater in a watercolor study.

text_led.rationale: Let the woman poet’s challenge to the judging gaze stand without adding a beauty portrait or a butterfly emblem that repeats that gaze.
The kept thing is deliberately unnamed. A specific object would collapse the productive uncertainty; retain a text-led opening.
The path and the speaker trade roles through Odia wordplay; a picturesque road would over-literalise the exchange.
